description: Some implementations allow forkchoice head-setting to trigger implicit execution/verification/canonicalization of a block that is only “known” (header/body present) but not “validated”. When local state is missing, the execution/verification fails. If the implementation:
fault_type: crash_recovery + byzantine_or_buggy_driver (misordered API calls / selective scheduling)
trigger_condition: - Node has block header/body for candidate head `C` (e.g., via DB pre-seed, sync path, or out-of-order delivery) but has **not** validated/executed it via the normal “payload import” API.
